title: Perceptual organization marks the step to conscious seeing

statements.text: Grouping, figure-ground segregation and the integration of features into objects happen only when a stimulus is consciously seen, so perceptual organization is the function at the center of the step from unconscious to conscious vision. Recurrent connections carry it.

sources.quote: It is argued that perceptual organization is the function that is central to understanding the transition from unconscious to conscious seeing.
while conscious functions related to perceptual organization are mediated by recurrent (feedback, or re-entrant) cortico-cortical connections
